proposals.note: Overhead wayfinding sign reads 'Town Square Gate 1'. An entrance to the Town Square, not a room.
Illustrated 'Put waste in the right place' bin beside the stair. An item, so it belongs as a detail once it has a footprint.
Racks with a 'Cyclists dismount your bike' sign. The facilities directory also lists Bicycle Bays on L1, so this is likely the same thing.
Escalator beside the bicycle bays. Destination inferred from the direction of travel, not read off a sign — check before accepting.
Hawker stall fascia reads 'MY HAPPY BELLY'. Clearly legible.
The open seating hall itself, with stalls on three sides. An area rather than a tenant.

proposals.nameEn: Bak kut teh stall (翠汁 · 什汤 · 肉骨茶)
proposals.note: Red fascia in Chinese; the English line under it is too small to read at this angle. Name is a description, not the trading name — needs confirming on site.
Yellow 'Thank you for returning your tray and crockery' station against the far wall.
Repeated 'Valu$' branding through the shopfront, with a 'lowest price' promotion. Confident.
Large wall lettering reading 'MAKANMALAH' along the corridor. Reads as an F&B zone name rather than a single unit.
Gantry sign reads 'Festive Mall @ B1'. No level recorded: the model has no basement, and the facilities directory also puts Festive Mall on B1.
Booth signed 'Ticket Counter 售票处', with a 'Sorry, we are closed' notice at the time of filming.
A row of claw and 'Hammer Men' machines on the green mat. Individual machines are items and should become details once someone draws them.
Second sighting: directional sign reads '... / Library / Town Square Gate 1'. Should link to the same place as the earlier frame.
Named on the LED banner as the venue for an event, and signed 'PLAZA' on the right. The open space itself.
